surfaces.name: Image proxy / URL-rewrite service
high_value_tests: SSRF — the url= param reaches the proxy; point it at 169.254.169.254 or an internal range
URL validation bypass — encoded/internal-scheme (file://, gopher://, 127.0.0.1) variants
XSS via image content — SVG/HTML payloads rendered inline

surfaces.name: URL redirect / safety proxy
high_value_tests: Open redirect — bypass the safety check to cloak phishing links
SSRF — the proxy fetches the target URL server-side
URL validation bypass — scheme/domain confusion (//, @, encoded chars)

surfaces.name: Edge cache / entity data service
high_value_tests: IDOR — read other entities (user/channel/tenant) by id without auth
Cache poisoning — inject a key that serves attacker content to other users
Unauthorized entity enumeration — bulk read via timestamp/resource pattern

surfaces.name: Payment / billing portal
high_value_tests: Price/amount manipulation — alter the client-side total before checkout
IDOR on invoices/payment records — read or modify other users' billing
Subscription tampering — upgrade/entitlement without payment
Auth bypass on checkout/order endpoints

surfaces.name: AI agent / no-code app builder
high_value_tests: Prompt injection → SSRF / RCE / data exfiltration via tool-call abuse
Insecure deserialization of tool-call arguments
Stored XSS in agent-generated output rendered in the dashboard

surfaces.name: File upload / download service
high_value_tests: XSS via file content — SVG/HTML served inline
SSRF via file URL / remote file fetch
Upload → RCE — executable file landing web-reachable

surfaces.name: Electron / desktop app
high_value_tests: HTML injection → BrowserWindow RCE (nodeIntegration + remote content)
Insecure IPC / preload bridge — expose privileged APIs to renderer
Remote content loading — hot-update/CDN resources replaced

surfaces.name: Authentication / SSO portal
high_value_tests: OAuth open redirect via redirect_uri manipulation
JWT alg:none / weak secret / missing expiry
Token leakage / account enumeration / 2FA bypass

note: Generalized attack-surface → high-value-test map, derived from public target-recon dossiers. Each surface is matched by fingerprint keywords against the detected tech stack/headers/body; when a surface is present, test its high-value cases FIRST (surface-first, not payload-spraying).
